title: Generic-fibre bound for dimensions in a flat family
statement: Let $S$ be an integral scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme] with generic point $\eta$, and let $f:Y\to S$ be a flat morphism locally of finite type [def-weil-flat-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. If $r\geq0$ is an integer and $\dim Y_\eta\leq r$, then $\dim Y_s\leq r$ for every point $s\in S$, where $Y_s=Y\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ is the scheme-theoretic fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre, def-weil-residue-field] and dimension is topological Krull dimension [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Empty fibres are allowed, with dimension $-\infty$.

source.place: Tag 0H3X, lemma-relative-dimension-support-flat, with the finite type quasi-coherent module O_Y (support equal to Y).
